items.title: Russia, Ukraine hold first mediated talks in nine months
items.feedTitle: Russia and Ukraine hold nearly 4 hours of U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi
items.summary: Russia and Ukraine conducted their first U.S.-mediated peace talks in nine months in Abu Dhabi, with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio calling the session "very productive" and Ukrainian President Zelenskyy describing it as "constructive and quite substantive." The talks lasted nearly four hours and are expected to resume, marking a significant diplomatic development after months of stalled negotiations.

items.title: Inflation hotter than expected, extending beyond fuel prices
items.feedTitle: Inflation runs hotter than expected as higher prices extend beyond the gas station
items.summary: U.S. inflation in October rose 0.4% month-over-month, higher than expected, as rising prices spread across categories beyond gasoline. The data raised concerns about sustained inflation pressures and prompted speculation about potential Federal Reserve rate hikes, posing challenges for the Biden administration and the Fed's inflation-control efforts.

items.title: Trump administration moves to limit SNAP food assistance eligibility
items.feedTitle: Trump Administration Moves to Further Limit SNAP Eligibility, Affecting Millions
items.summary: The Trump administration is pursuing policy shifts at the USDA to restrict Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) eligibility, potentially cutting millions of Americans off food aid. The move would affect a substantial portion of the population relying on federal food assistance programs.

items.title: Nvidia CEO admits affair with alleged Chinese intelligence operative
items.feedTitle: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces scrutiny over alleged affair with Chinese spy
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese spy, triggering a board investigation and raising national security concerns. The revelation has implications for U.S.-China tech competition and AI infrastructure development, given Nvidia's critical role in powering artificial intelligence systems.

items.title: Supreme Court allows border wall construction in Big Bend, Texas
items.feedTitle: News Wrap: Supreme Court allows border wall construction in Big Bend
items.summary: The Supreme Court granted the Trump administration's emergency request to continue building a section of border wall in a remote part of Texas that includes Big Bend National Park. The ruling allows construction to proceed while litigation over the project moves forward.

stlouis.title: St. Louis receives $68 million federal grant to combat violent crime
stlouis.feedTitle: Schmitt Touts $68 Million Federal Award for St. Louis Law Enforcement - The Missouri Times -
stlouis.summary: The Trump administration awarded St. Louis more than $68 million in federal funding to support law enforcement efforts in combating violent crime. Federal officials emphasized the need for the grant to be deployed effectively as a success measure for the program.

stlouis.title: Traffic-calming measures show positive impact on St. Louis corridors
stlouis.feedTitle: Positive direction on major St. Louis corridors as Trailnet explores the impact of traffic-calming measures on crashes
stlouis.summary: Trailnet is exploring how traffic-calming measures have affected crash rates on major St. Louis corridors, showing positive direction in road safety initiatives. The analysis examines the effectiveness of these infrastructure changes in reducing traffic incidents.

stlouis.title: 14-year-old charged as adult in deadly shooting after St. Louis County track meet
stlouis.feedTitle: 14-year-old charged as adult in deadly shooting after St. Louis County track meet
stlouis.summary: A 14-year-old was charged as an adult in connection with a fatal shooting that occurred following a St. Louis County track meet. The case reflects ongoing violence concerns in the metro area involving youth offenders.

items.title: Woman convicted of sexual assault after posing as male deceiver
items.feedTitle: Woman jailed for posing as man to dupe partner into sex found guilty of similar deception
items.summary: Blade Silvano, who was serving time for sexual assault after pretending to be a man to dupe a partner into a physical relationship, has been found guilty of similar deception against another woman. A jury convicted her of six counts of sexual assault in the second case.

items.title: Trinidad and Tobago overturns anti-homosexuality laws after 10-year legal fight
items.feedTitle: Anti-homosexuality laws in Trinidad and Tobago overturned
items.summary: The UK Privy Council has ruled to overturn anti-gay laws in Trinidad and Tobago, ending an 11-year legal battle brought by activist Jason Jones. The landmark decision could help overturn similar homophobic legislation in other Caribbean nations.

items.title: At least 12 killed in Bulgarian motorway pile-up during heavy fog
items.feedTitle: At least 12 people killed in Bulgaria motorway pile-up
items.summary: Heavy fog triggered multiple massive collisions on Bulgaria's Trakia motorway involving approximately 50 vehicles, killing at least 12 people and injuring around 50 others. The incident represents one of the worst highway disasters in recent Bulgarian history.

items.title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion valuation in record-breaking IPO
items.feedTitle: Anthropic targets valuation of up to $1.4tn in stock market flotation
items.summary: Claude chatbot developer Anthropic is seeking a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion in its upcoming stock market flotation, representing one of the largest IPOs in history. The valuation is lower than the $2 trillion initially expected as investor enthusiasm for AI companies has cooled.

items.title: 'It's a farce': Hegseth's defiant response to impeachment effort
items.feedTitle: 'It's a farce': Hegseth's defiant response to impeachment effort

items.title: India brokering Black Sea grain corridor as friend to both Russia and Ukraine
items.feedTitle: ‘Friends with both’: Can India broker a Black Sea breakthrough?
items.summary: India is exploring its role as a potential mediator for restoring food exports from Ukraine through the Black Sea, leveraging its diplomatic relationships with both Moscow and Kyiv. The initiative seeks to address global food security concerns amid the ongoing conflict.

items.title: Former Bangladesh PM Hasina seeks passport to return from India exile
items.feedTitle: What is Hasina’s game plan as she seeks a passport to return to Bangladesh?
items.summary: Sonia Gandhi's memoir reveals former Bangladesh PM Sheikh Hasina is seeking to return to her country from exile in India, though Bangladesh has ruled out issuing her a passport. India has indicated it may provide a travel document to facilitate her return.

items.title: Three workers die from toxic gas at Tata iPhone parts plant in Tamil Nadu
items.feedTitle: Three workers die at Tata’s iPhone parts plant in India’s Tamil Nadu
items.summary: Three workers died from asphyxiation after inhaling toxic gas at Tata Electronics' iPhone manufacturing facility in Tamil Nadu, marking another safety incident at the plant. The deaths raise concerns about workplace safety in India's electronics manufacturing sector.

items.title: Sonia Gandhi recalls love, loss, and political evolution in new memoir
items.feedTitle: In Interview, Sonia Gandhi Recalls Love and Loss in India
items.summary: In her newly released memoir "Belonging," Sonia Gandhi provides an insider's account of India's political evolution, including personal losses such as the assassination of her husband Rajiv Gandhi and the death of their first newborn child. The book also discusses her experiences with India's political establishment under various administrations.

items.title: NASA satellite captures thick smog blanket over North India post-Diwali
items.feedTitle: NASA satellite image captures thick blanket of haze covering North India after Diwali
items.summary: NASA satellite imagery shows a thick haze and smog covering northern India days after Diwali celebrations, with pollution levels peaking across the region. The seasonal air quality crisis affects major cities including Delhi and surrounding areas, reflecting ongoing concerns about post-festival pollution.

immigration.title: IBM ends visa and green card sponsorship for most consulting roles
immigration.feedTitle: H-1B, Green Card update: IBM ends visa sponsorship for most roles in its biggest division; affected worke
immigration.summary: IBM announced it is ending immigration sponsorship for most roles in its Consulting unit, its largest division. The move reflects tighter U.S. visa policies and represents a significant pullback in the company's visa and green card sponsorship programs.

immigration.title: Trump administration ends automatic work permit extensions (finalized, in effect)
immigration.feedTitle: Trump administration confirms end of automatic work permit extension: What immigrants need to do to renew their EAD
immigration.summary: An interim final rule published October 30, 2025, terminated automatic extensions of employment authorization documents (EADs) for aliens who timely file renewal applications. This rule is finalized and now in effect, requiring workers to proactively renew permits rather than relying on automatic extensions.

immigration.title: U.S. sets course for largest mass visa revocation in history targeting 200,000 foreigners
immigration.feedTitle: US set for largest mass visa revocation in history targeting up to 200,000 foreigners, officials say
immigration.summary: U.S. officials say the nation is preparing what could become the largest mass visa revocation in history, potentially affecting up to 200,000 foreign nationals. The proposed policy change remains pending and is not yet final, but represents a significant shift in immigration enforcement.

items.title: Nasdaq plunges 1.6% as hot inflation data pushes yields above 5%
items.feedTitle: Nasdaq Plunges 1.6% as Hot US Inflation Sends Treasury Yields Above 5%
items.summary: U.S. stock markets fell sharply after October inflation data came in hotter than expected, sending Treasury yields above 5% and fueling speculation about potential Federal Reserve rate hikes. The Nasdaq declined 1.6% as investors reassessed inflation risks and monetary policy trajectories.

items.title: Anthropic sets IPO price at $70-$78 per share, targeting $1.4 trillion valuation
items.feedTitle: EXCLUSIVE: Anthropic eyes $1.4 trillion IPO valuation in test of Wall Street's AI fervor
items.summary: Anthropic priced its initial public offering at $70 to $78 per share, implying a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.404 trillion. The company is expected to begin trading November 19, marking one of the largest IPO valuations in history despite earlier expectations of a $2 trillion target.

items.title: U.S. gas prices fall below $4 per gallon for first time since July
items.feedTitle: U.S. gas prices fall below $4 for the first time since July
items.summary: U.S. gasoline prices dipped below $4 per gallon for the first time since July as crude oil declined, partly due to Trump's statements de-escalating tensions with Iran. Despite falling fuel costs, broader inflation remains stubbornly elevated.

items.title: Oil prices extend decline after Trump signals restraint on Iran confrontation
items.feedTitle: Oil prices fall to lowest since August as Trump says Iran war is ‘effectively over’
items.summary: Brent crude fell below $90 per barrel for the first time since August as President Trump stated that resuming the Iran war is "highly unlikely" and the U.S. is maintaining a "status quo." The market interpreted his comments as a de-escalation of geopolitical tensions.

items.title: Citi raises Nifty 50 target to 28,000 with 12% upside forecast
items.feedTitle: Citi Expects Nifty To Hit 28,000 By December 2027, Raises Target On Earnings Optimism
items.summary: Citi raised its Nifty 50 price target to 28,000 by December 2027, citing earnings growth and lower oil prices as tailwinds for Indian equities. The upgrade signals bullish sentiment on India's stock market despite recent volatility.

cards.title: Inflation Still Outpacing Wage Growth
cards.insight: October CPI came in 0.4% month-over-month, hotter than expected, signaling that inflation pressures remain sticky beyond fuel prices. Real purchasing power continues to erode if your salary raises lag price increases.
cards.takeaway: Review your annual salary expectations and bonus structure; consider shifting discretionary spending toward fixed-rate purchases or locking in utility/subscription costs before potential further price hikes.

cards.title: Tech Job Market Tightening: IBM Cuts Visa Sponsorships
cards.insight: IBM is ending visa and green card sponsorship for most consulting roles—a major employer's pullback that signals broader tech sector retrenchment on immigration support. This may reduce opportunities for foreign talent and affect career mobility.
cards.takeaway: If you're on an H-1B or pursuing visa sponsorship, expand your job search beyond tech giants; smaller startups and non-tech sectors may still sponsor. Accelerate green card timeline if eligible, given regulatory tightening.

cards.title: Gas Prices Drop Below $4, But Don't Bet on It Lasting
cards.insight: U.S. gas prices fell below $4 per gallon for the first time since July, driven partly by Trump's de-escalation on Iran and falling crude. However, geopolitical tensions remain fragile, and oil volatility could reverse gains quickly.
cards.takeaway: Lock in transportation cost savings (fuel-efficient routes, carpools, transit passes) while prices are low; avoid assuming further declines. Consider auto insurance and maintenance bundling to hedge against future volatility.

cards.title: Fed Rate Hike Risk Rising Despite Inflation Progress
cards.insight: Hot CPI data is fueling speculation of a possible 0.5-point Fed rate hike in early 2027, contrary to earlier expectations of rate cuts. Mortgage, credit card, and auto loan rates could rise sharply if the Fed pivots hawkish.
cards.takeaway: If you're planning to borrow (mortgage, auto, refinance), lock in rates now before Fed decisions in December. High-yield savings rates may also compress—consider laddering CDs or short-term Treasuries for predictable returns.

ai.title: OpenAI lets businesses claim ChatGPT profiles, launches AI agents for e-commerce
ai.feedTitle: OpenAI lets businesses claim ChatGPT profiles, adds AI agents for US e-commerce firms
ai.summary: OpenAI announced that businesses can now claim and control ChatGPT profiles while the company launched AI agents specifically designed for U.S. e-commerce firms. The move represents OpenAI's push to deepen enterprise adoption and provide business-specific AI solutions.

ai.title: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings for workplace collaboration and task automation
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic launches Claude Meetings to turn workplace discussions into plans and tasks
ai.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Meetings, enabling Claude to participate in workplace discussions via Google Meet and other platforms. The AI can draft plans, create timelines, answer questions in chat, and integrate with work apps—marking Anthropic's entry into enterprise productivity tools.

ai.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent 'swarm' feature capability
ai.feedTitle: Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
ai.summary: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, its most powerful AI model, featuring an agent 'swarm' capability that allows multiple AI agents to coordinate tasks. The model is now widely available globally and represents Google's latest advance in large language model development.

ai.title: Adobe integrates Google's latest AI models into creative and productivity tools
ai.feedTitle: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
ai.summary: Adobe announced plans to integrate Google's newest AI models into Photoshop, Premiere, Firefly, and other creative tools, expanding its AI-powered features. The integration will bring advanced AI capabilities to Adobe's suite of content creation and productivity applications.

ai.feedTitle: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy: a timeline
ai.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese government intelligence agent, sparking board investigation and national security review.
